description: CSS animation and transition events on virtual time (CSS slice 3b): animationstart, animationiteration and animationend with elapsedTime (two iterations, a delay, a negative delay, a ::before animation with pseudoElement); transitionrun, transitionstart and transitionend, and a reversal half way (transitioncancel, then a shortened transition); display: none on an ancestor (animationcancel bubbling to the ancestor's listener) and shown again (a new animationstart); a document listener after the element's; the order in a frame against the animation's finished reaction and the animation frame callbacks (also those the reaction and a listener request, which run in the same frame)
